findings.title: MISSING_HORIZON_JOINT_CHRONOLOGY_SEMANTICS
findings.issue: joint_eligibility implies excluding rows lacking any required horizon, while missing_required_horizon=INVALID_INPUT_DO_NOT_IMPUTE implies fail-close invalid input.
findings.consequence: Different implementations can produce different joint n, window length, candidate mapping, metrics, and common-N.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze exactly one rule: STRICT_COMPLETE_DATASET or PREDEFINED_JOINT_ELIGIBILITY_FILTER, including status/failure behavior.

findings.title: JOINT_CHRONOLOGY_HASH_CANONICALIZATION_UNDEFINED
findings.issue: joint_chronology_hash is required in result identity but canonical payload, serialization, date/numeric representation, and hash rule are unspecified.
findings.consequence: Identical metric outputs may have non-identical result identities across implementations.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze canonical chronology payload + canonical serialization + SHA256 rule.

findings.title: NUMERIC_COMPARISON_CANONICALIZATION_UNDEFINED
findings.issue: T_EMP/L_EMP/S_EMP can be exact rational values but policy tolerance representation/comparison precision is unspecified.
findings.consequence: Boundary cases may differ between SUPPORTED_WITHIN_POLICY and EXCEEDS_POLICY, changing common-N.
findings.required_resolution: Freeze exact numeric representation and <= comparison semantics without implementation-dependent binary-float tolerance.
